verdict.rationale: Linear is an issue tracker, so switching between layouts of the same work is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack never documents board, list, calendar, or timeline layouts, or toggling between them. The closest items are shareable filtered views, project-view subscriptions, and a marketing mention of strategic roadmaps; these are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can switch between board, list, calendar, and timeline views of the same work
